description: This file contains a report implementation for bank remittance in the ERPNext payroll module, including functions to fetch and process payroll and employee bank details.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the bank remittance report, returning columns and data.

methods.name: get_payroll_entries
methods.description: Retrieves payroll entries filtered by accounts and date range.

methods.name: get_salary_slips
methods.description: Fetches salary slips associated with payroll entries and maps debit accounts.

methods.name: get_emp_bank_ifsc_code
methods.description: Retrieves IFSC codes for employees and adds to salary slips.

methods.name: set_company_account
methods.description: Associates payroll entries with their respective company bank account numbers.
